limits.onlyShellTransport: Exact packet reads and hashes of own deliverables; own writes used apply_patch.
limits.verification: Manual contract review only; no runtime or type validation performed.

design.owner: Four exported native async functions, private option type aliases, and no auxiliary state or await wrappers.
design.organization: Boundary publication first, caller adapters next, workflow message persistence last.
design.conventionalProtocolGlue: Direct receiver-bound awaits and call adapters, optional property spreads, protocol record literals, and tool-name mapping.
design.mutableReads: Only contract-required message ID, trace, canonical input, turn ID, and created timestamp are captured; remaining mutable reads stay at their contract evaluation points.
design.moduleLimit: Single source module under 400 physical lines; no suppressions, added exports, policy, retry, queue, cache, or sidecar state.
